reviews.summary: No current, directly FLUID-specific exploit, outage, listing/delisting, governance, or scheduled-unlock event was identified around the November 5, 2026 signal time. A prior rewards-distribution key compromise is historical, not a newly reported incident.

facts.fact: Fluid’s official support page identifies FLUID as the Fluid/Instadapp ecosystem token and directs users to Fluid’s official blog, governance forum, and security channels. ([fluid-support.zendesk.com](https://fluid-support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/29380262202652-Official-Fluid-links-impersonation-and-Discord-bans?utm_source=openai))
DefiLlama’s unlock tracker reported no upcoming FLUID token unlocks as of November 3, 2026. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/fluid?utm_source=openai))

A May 2026 operational-key compromise affected Fluid’s Merkle rewards-distribution infrastructure; reported scope excluded core protocol contracts, lending markets, and user deposits. This is not a fresh incident. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/protocol/fluid?dexVolume=true&events=false&tvl=false&utm_source=openai))

Phemex’s FLUID/USDT spot delisting occurred on August 18, 2026, and does not indicate a current disruption to the FLUID-EUR market. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100899?utm_source=openai))
